annotations.title: Exit window: out before or after the largest holders

description: Can I still get out if the big holders leave first? For one vault: what can be withdrawn now, what would be left if its largest holder and its five largest holders left first, how many of them it takes to empty the instant exit, who they are where an operator names them (Spark, Grove liquidity layers), and the run across markets: other tracked vaults lending into the same markets and the pro-rata exit if all of them withdrew at once. With position (USD) and address: the share of your position that could leave now, after the largest holder, after the five largest. Without vault: the vaults it takes the fewest holders to empty, tightest first. Queues and locks are said apart. A scenario under stated assumptions, not a forecast. A vault we hold whose holders or instant liquidity are not read answers with availability not_read, reason, missingConditions and nextStep (not an error); only a vault we do not hold is not found. FREE.

address.description: With position: your address, so you are not counted among the holders ahead of you.

limit.description: Without vault: how many vaults (default 20, at most 200).

position.description: With vault: your position in USD.

vault.description: A vault slug or id. Omit for the tightest vaults.

name: vault_exit_window

answerLead.description: SINCE 2026-11-28: at most three lines before the full answer, from its own fields: `text`, `result`, `risks` (up to two), `asOf`, `coverage`, `unknowns` (up to two) and `deprecatedFields` (legacy duplicates this answer still carries). The full answer governs. Added by this MCP server; the REST route behind the tool does not carry it.

availability.description: read on every answer with figures (the list, and a vault with its window); not_read (since 2026-11-27) where a vault we hold has no exit window read (HTTP 200, not an error). Always present since 2026-11-28.

meta.description: How current this answer is and what it was read from: `freshness` and the ages behind it. Present on every answer from this server, whatever the tool.

missingConditions.description: With availability not_read: the readings that are missing (condition, says); null when read.

nextStep.description: With availability not_read: what to call instead; null when read.

position.description: now, afterLargest, afterTop5 (shares of your position, 0..1), holdersAheadToBlock.

reason.description: data_not_indexed or insufficient_coverage, with availability not_read; null when read. An unknown vault is a 404 with reason subject_not_found.

vault.description: withdrawableUsd, afterLargestUsd, afterTop5Usd, holdersToEmpty, largest, ahead, run, mechanic, says. Null in the list form, and (since 2026-11-27) where the vault exists and its exit window is not read: then availability is not_read.

vaults.description: Without vault: the tightest vaults first.

warnings.description: Anything the server wants a caller to know about THIS answer before acting on it, each {code, message, says} with message and says the same sentence. Empty is the normal case and is not a guarantee.
